title: Infrastructure Engineer (Azure • Elixir)
description:
Infrastructure Engineer (Azure • Elixir)



Who We Are Seeking:


We seek a talented and experienced DevOps/Distributed Systems Engineer to operate and harden our Elixir services and Hyperledger Besu nodes network on Microsoft Azure. This role presents an excellent opportunity for those looking to work in a dynamic environment and be part of a high-performing international team, offering ample opportunities for growth and development in technical and interpersonal skills. 



Your Role and Responsibilities will be to design, set up, and operate:


  • Elixir stack – Elixir/OTP, Phoenix, Ecto, Oban, and OpenTelemetry nodes and services.

  • Besu on Azure – validators/peers, permissioning, bootnodes, IBFT/QBFT configs, genesis updates, hard-fork rollouts, RPC/WS endpoints behind Azure gateways.

  • Storage & performance – tune Besu (JVM/RocksDB), use Premium SSD v2 / Ultra Disk, optimise IOPS/throughput, and set up snapshot/restore via Azure Blob Storage.

  • Networking – secure VNets/subnets with Azure CNI (Cilium), NSGs, Private Endpoints/Private Link, NAT Gateway, and VNet peering/ExpressRoute.

  • Traffic & ingress – expose RPC/WS via Azure Application Gateway or Nginx Ingress with WAF, mTLS, rate limiting, and IP allowlists.

  • Secrets & keys – manage validator keys and app secrets using Key Vault / Managed HSM, Managed Identities, and least-privilege RBAC via Entra ID.

  • CI/CD & GitOps – deliver immutable releases with GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps, ACR (signing/scanning), Helm, and Argo CD or Flux.

  • Observability & SRE – Azure Monitor + Log Analytics, Managed or self-managed Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry traces, alerting, runbooks, SLOs and error budgets.

    • Essential Qualifications:  


    • 5+ years in DevOps/SRE/Platform roles running distributed systems in production.
    • Strong Azure background: AKS, VNet/NSG/Private Link, Key Vault, ACR, Azure Monitor/Log Analytics, and Application Gateway/WAF.
    • Solid Linux and networking fundamentals (TLS, DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing).
    • Proven observability practice: metrics, logs, traces, actionable alerting, SLOs/runbooks.
    • Excellent written and spoken English (daily collaboration across teams).


    Who We Are:


    DevGrid is a top-tier software consulting company based in the UK, with a development hub in Brazil and operations spanning Europe and the US. We believe that world-class software can only be created by a motivated and enthusiastic team in an environment that fosters creativity and free thinking. Established in 2015, we aim to drive innovation and digital transformation by combining our robust business culture and exceptional engineers with forward-thinking business insights.


    What We Offer:


    • Contract-based hiring;
    • Full-time opportunity (40 hours per week);
    • 100% remote work/home office;
    • Performance-based bonuses tied to achievements and deliverables;
    • Open and flexible time-off policy;
    • Supportive and collaborative work environment;
    • Equipment program;
    • Paid days off per year + holidays (variable) + recess days;
    • Sponsorship program for relevant courses and training.


    For more information, visit:

    Website:

    Glassdoor:


    **All DevGrid positions are open to individuals from all backgrounds (including all races, colors, nationalities, religions, genders, sexual orientations, disabilities, ages, or other applicable characteristics), promoting equal opportunities and affirmative action.


    If you're interested in the job opening and our mission, come join us on this journey!

    Live long and prosper!

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development : Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development : Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration : Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization : Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance : Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery : Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Application Developer (Maintenance - JAVA/MySQL)
description:
We are looking for an Application Developer with strong experience in Java and MySQL to support and enhance our client's application system, on the transportation product line.

The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities

title: Desenvolvedor SAP ABAP Fiori
description:
Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori

Local: 100% remoto

Regime: PJ ou Coop

Nível: Sênior


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Sênior ABAP / Fiori para atuar em projetos estratégicos de modernização e evolução tecnológica no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform) .

O profissional será responsável por desenvolver soluções modernas utilizando ABAP Cloud e RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 , aplicando boas práticas de clean core e arquitetura extensível.

Além das iniciativas mais modernas, é importante que o profissional possua base sólida em ABAP Clássico , garantindo flexibilidade para atuar em demandas tradicionais quando necessário.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e extensões com ABAP Cloud / RAP integradas a SAP Fiori / UI5 .
  • Implementar e manter serviços OData, CDS Views e AMDPs para consumo em interfaces Fiori.
  • Trabalhar em ambiente SAP S/4HANA e SAP BTP , aplicando conceitos de clean core e extensibilidade .
  • Apoiar arquitetos e consultores funcionais na definição e entrega de soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir performance, segurança e qualidade de código nas entregas.
  • Contribuir com revisões de código, boas práticas e mentoria técnica para o time.
  • Atuar também, quando necessário, em demandas ABAP Clássico , mantendo soluções legadas e promovendo sua evolução gradativa para o novo modelo.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • 5+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento ABAP , com domínio de ABAP Clássico e ABAP Cloud .
  • Experiência sólida com RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) .
  • Domínio de SAP Fiori / SAP UI5 e Fiori Elements .
  • Conhecimento em CDS Views , OData Services , AMDPs e integrações RESTful .
  • Experiência com SAP S/4HANA e ferramentas modernas de desenvolvimento (Eclipse ADT, Git, transportes em BTP ).
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e trabalho colaborativo em times ágeis.


Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) .
  • Experiência com SAP BTP , extensões side-by-side e integrações em nuvem.
  • Certificação SAP ABAP for Cloud ou SAP BTP.
  • Experiência em S/4HANA Cloud (Public ou Private Edition) .

title: Data Engineer \"988743\"
description:
Quem Somos


A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.


Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver e manter mapeamentos e workflows no Informatica PowerCenter, garantindo a correta extração, transformação e carga de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes para o Data Warehouse.

Realizar análises e profiling de dados complexos, identificando inconsistências, padrões, problemas de qualidade e oportunidades de otimização antes e durante o processo de ETL.

Criar, revisar e otimizar queries Oracle SQL complexas, incluindo joins avançados, subqueries e ajustes de performance para suportar processos de ingestão e consumo de dados.

Implementar, monitorar e dar suporte a workflows ETL no Informatica, assegurando execução eficiente, tratamento de erros, reprocessamentos e cumprimento de SLAs.

Produzir documentação técnica e realizar transferência de conhecimento (KT), detalhando fluxos de dados, regras de negócio, dependências e boas práticas para garantir continuidade e escalabilidade das soluções.


O que você precisa ter


  • Inglês avançado para conversação;
  • Informatica PowerCenter
  • Oracle SQL;
  • ETL.


Onde você vai trabalhar


No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Teradata Developer
description:
A Job? Or a Lifetime Experience? Start Yours Here!


**Please note that we're aiming at an expatriation to Portugal**


We are a Portuguese technology consulting company with a strong outward look to the rest of Europe. We have 12 years of experience in the market and reached the status of “large company” in 2018. We now have more than 350 associates and we keep growing, with offices in Lisbon, Porto, and Leiria , as well as projects in more than 20 countries. Our company is part of the national top 10, with a growth of 250% in the last years.


Work-life balance is part of our DNA. We focus on win-win-win relationships, defining every moment of interaction as an experience with unique conditions. Working with Affinity is a “Lifetime Experience ” where you will have the opportunity to demonstrate all your potential and to be successful on every level.


#welcometoyourfuture


What you need to have

  • College degree in IT Engineering or similar areas;
  • At least 3-5 years of professional experience in Data Engineering or Data Warehousing;.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Teradata platform ;
  • Good proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and query optimization;
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems and shell scripting;
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and basic DevOps practices;
  • Experience with Teradata utilities (BTEQ, TPT, FastLoad, MultiLoad, or similar);
  • Good level of English (minimum B2 level)
  • Basic knowledge of French (A1 level) is a plus;
  • Availability to relocate and live in Portugal with our support;


What we expect from you

  • Will to exceed expectations (your own and the ones defined by Affinity);
  • Exceptional skills and the will to acquire more;
  • Good people skills (not just in terms of technology, language, and platforms), team spirit, and pleasant disposition;
  • Autonomy, proactivity, and focus (even under pressure);
  • Obsession for doing things right, and ability to prioritize;
  • Ability to innovate and evolve in a market in constant mutation.


What will encourage you

  • Being part of a company that has a disruptive action in the technology market;
  • Being part of a technology focused on relationships, simplicity, and efficiency;
  • Accessing a generative career directly proportional to your performance and interest;
  • The real possibility of being part of our company staff.


Do you think you're the one we are looking for?

title: Advogado - Reestruturação e Insolvência
description:
O RSSA – Ricardo Siqueira Sociedade de Advogados é referência nacional em recuperação judicial e demais medidas para estabilização da insolvência empresarial, com prática reconhecida por rankings internacionais como Chambers e Legal 500.


Oferecemos desafios jurídicos de alto nível, em um ambiente moderno, colaborativo , que valoriza o desenvolvimento intelectual e a atuação estratégica.


Requisitos da vaga


  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em processos de recuperação judicial, extrajudicial ou contencioso cível envolvendo empresas em crise;
  • Desejável pós-graduação (em andamento ou concluída) em Direito Empresarial, Recuperação Judicial e Falências ou Processo Civil.


Habilidades esperadas


  • Capacidade para administrar prazos e providências;
  • Boa comunicação verbal;
  • Organização e foco no cliente;
  • Escrita clara e objetiva.


O que oferecemos

  • Remuneração e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado;
  • Participação em casos complexos e de grande repercussão social;
  • Ambiente de aprendizado contínuo e valorização da carreira.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de NLP Sênior
description:
Sobre a Letrus

A Letrus desenvolve soluções para fortalecer a leitura e a escrita de estudantes do Ensino Fundamental II e do Ensino Médio, com foco nas redes públicas de ensino. Utilizamos inteligência artificial e ciência da linguagem para apoiar professores e enfrentar um dos grandes desafios do país: o alto índice de pessoas não plenamente letradas.


Nosso programa tem validação da UNESCO e do J-PAL (MIT) e já integra políticas públicas em estados e municípios brasileiros. Para saber mais sobre a gente, visite nossa página !


Sobre o desafio

Estamos em um momento de expansão da capacidade produtiva e de amadurecimento técnico da nossa área de dados e IA. Buscamos uma pessoa sênior em dados, com forte atuação em Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP) , para integrar o time. Essa posição atua de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de análise textual em escala, com impacto direto em produtos educacionais. Além da excelência técnica em dados, esperamos alguém com capacidade de dialogar com times de engenharia, arquitetura e produto, entendendo limitações, propondo soluções viáveis e acompanhando o ciclo completo das aplicações, do experimento ao deploy.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, avaliar e evoluir modelos de NLP aplicados à análise textual (classificação, similaridade semântica, avaliação automática, LLMs, etc.);
  • Participar do desenho de arquiteturas de soluções de dados, em parceria com engenharia e arquitetura de software;
  • Acompanhar e apoiar o deploy de modelos e serviços, considerando aspectos de escalabilidade, custo, observabilidade e manutenção;
  • Definir e monitorar métricas de qualidade e desempenho dos modelos em produção;
  • Contribuir tecnicamente com decisões de produto, trazendo visão crítica sobre limites e possibilidades das soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Apoiar a evolução técnica do time, atuando como referência em boas práticas.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida como pessoa sênior em dados , com foco em NLP / Processamento de Linguagem Natural .
  • Domínio de Python e bibliotecas usuais de NLP, manipulação de dados e machine learning;
  • Experiência com modelos de machine learning clássico;
  • Experiência com LLMs em produção;
  • Experiência prática com pipelines de dados e modelos em produção;
  • Familiaridade com ambientes de deploy (APIs, containers, cloud, monitoramento);
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com times técnicos diversos (engenharia, arquitetura, produto).


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência com FastAPI, serviços assíncronos ou arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Experiência em contextos de produtos educacionais ou análise textual complexa;
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes com alto volume de dados e necessidade de qualidade rigorosa.


Modelo de contratação e benefícios:

CLT | Remota

Benefícios: Plano de Saúde 100% custeado pela empresa e benefícios no cartão Caju, com um valor total de R$ 1.150,00 distribuídos entre alimentação, refeição, auxílio home office e educação. Também contamos com auxílio creche, licenças maternidade e paternidade estendidas, parceria com a Creditas — que inclui educação financeira, empréstimo consignado e previdência privada (redução de taxas) —, acesso ao TotalPass, convênio com o SESC e pontes de feriados nacionais sem descontos, além de recesso remunerado entre o Natal e o Ano Novo.

title: Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer (JavaScript, PHP, linux)
description:
We are looking for a full-time remote Senior Full Stack Web Application Developer with 7+ years of experience producing commercial grade software that is highly maintainable and supportable. The ideal candidate will be highly adept at working in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment with a small team, have proven on-time delivery experience, strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly, and be trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent.

Our industry-leading client provides cloud-based business automation software for over 2000 independent upstream and midstream oil & gas companies in North America. The companys solutions manage land, production, accounting, and transportation for E&P operators, crude oil purchasers, transporters, haulers, investors, and accounting firms. Their customers benefit through the automation of the most complex business processes to reduce operating costs, save time, and increase profitability via reporting, analytics, and decision support systems that were once exclusive to the major integrated oil companies.


Responsibilities:

  • Maintain and enhance legacy application - JavaScript frontend and PHP backend running on linux, nginx (engine x), fpm and mostly mysql
  • Modernize software solution using React.js and/or Vue.js design, architect, develop, deliver, and sustain
  • Take technical ownership of features and their impact on the business - assist with refining functional and technical specifications
  • Deliver product features and updates with minimal direction, yet know when to seek help to remain efficient
  • Review and approve pull requests from less senior developers and assure alignment with established best practices
  • Build and execute unit tests
  • Interact with end-users/customers to ensure smooth deployments and to understand needs/issues
  • Address defects identified during various testing cycles
  • Participate in daily standups and weekly team meetings to review priorities, progress, new ideas, and technologies
  • Display comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), as applied to projects of increasing size and complexity, with emphasis on:
  • Problem solving
  • Critical thinking
  • Analysis and design
  • Estimating
  • Planning


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • 4+ years of experience using JavaScript, PHP, and linux
  • Passion for whole product delivery and exceptional customer experiences must have experience considering architectural side-effects, edge-cases, backward compatibility, integrations, and internal/external team/customer enablement
  • Experience building, delivering, and sustaining production, commercial-quality, n-tiered software architecture web-based applications
  • Prior success as a senior developer coaching less skilled/experienced developers, establishing coding guidelines/best-practices, and reviewing pull requests
  • Familiarity with varied data capture, normalization/transformation, and storage/management that enable high-performance data querying for reporting
  • Experience working with Agile and other development methodologies
  • Ability to work independently yet know when to seek assistance to be sure to achieve deadlines with high quality
  • Team player with effective communication skills and collaborative approach
  • Strong problem-solving abilities as well as aptitude to learn new technologies and concepts quickly
  • Flexibility and openness to new ideas or change with the passion and drive to excel in their career
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, creative, and accountable


Preferred experience:

  • University degree or equivalent education (technical or engineering degree is optimal)
  • Familiar with nginx web server (aka \"Engine X\")
  • Experience with React.js or Vue.js
  • Familiarity with upstream and midstream oil/gas industry


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - Think Big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Cientista de dados
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Responsabilidades

Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento de modelos estatísticos e preditivos avançados;

Atuar em desafios complexos de análise preditiva e modelagem customizada;

Propor melhorias, inovações e novas abordagens de modelagem;

Avaliar, validar e aprimorar modelos existentes;

Apoiar tecnicamente outros cientistas de dados do time;

Garantir aderência técnica e alinhamento dos modelos às necessidades de negócio e ao ciclo de crédito.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

Ensino superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharias, Física ou áreas correlatas;

Conhecimento avançado em estatística, machine learning e modelagem preditiva;

Ampla experiência em manipulação e análise de dados;

Forte domínio de programação (Python e/ou R);

Conhecimento sólido do ciclo de crédito;

Capacidade de atuar com autonomia técnica e tomada de decisão.


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas

- Seguro de vida

- Parceria com instituições de ensino

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!

Projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.

title: Especialista em Operações Jurídicas
description:
Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo!


A EasyJur é uma legaltech que está transformando a advocacia através da tecnologia. Nossa missão é eliminar 10 bilhões de horas de trabalho repetitivo para 2 milhões de advogados até 2033, redesenhando a forma como escritórios e departamentos jurídicos operam. Estamos em ritmo acelerado de crescimento e buscamos um líder de operações para levar nossa estrutura ao próximo nível.


Descrição da vaga


Estamos em busca de um Especialista em Operações Jurídicas para atuar no núcleo da operação, garantindo organização, disciplina e excelência na execução dos fluxos. Este profissional terá papel essencial na estruturação, supervisão e auditoria da operação, assegurando previsibilidade, qualidade e padronização em grande escala.

É um perfil de alto nível técnico, com experiência consolidada em gestão de correspondentes, prazos e logística jurídica, apto a mitigar erros e dar sustentação à operação em ritmo de crescimento acelerado.


Responsabilidades


  • Estruturar fluxos e processos operacionais, garantindo padronização, clareza e eficiência em todas as etapas da operação.
  • Auditar rotinas e controles internos, supervisionando a qualidade das entregas e assegurando conformidade com os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Supervisionar e coordenar o time de analistas, fornecendo direcionamento técnico, acompanhamento contínuo e promovendo desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Mitigar erros e intercorrências operacionais, atuando de forma preventiva e corretiva para manter a previsibilidade e confiabilidade da operação.
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de audiências, diligências e prazos, assegurando precisão e qualidade.
  • Controlar e organizar a atuação de correspondentes jurídicos em diversos estados.
  • Realizar auditoria de atas, conferência de informações e alinhamento direto com clientes.
  • Implementar e monitorar planilhas, relatórios e controles de performance da operação.
  • Garantir aderência aos procedimentos internos e às melhores práticas de logística jurídica.
  • Apoiar a gestão na identificação de gargalos operacionais e propor melhorias de processo.
  • Atuar com disciplina e previsibilidade, assegurando o cumprimento de SLA’s e metas da operação.
  • Definir, monitorar e evoluir KPIs estratégicos e operacionais, garantindo que as metas sejam atingidas com previsibilidade.
  • Liderar o planejamento e execução de projetos estratégicos, integrando operações com Produto, Vendas e Marketing.
  • Implementar metodologias ágeis e ferramentas que aumentem a eficiência operacional.
  • Ser parceiro estratégico da liderança executiva, apoiando na definição e execução do plano de crescimento da equipe.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência consolidada em operações jurídicas e/ou contencioso em massa (logística de correspondentes, gestão de audiências, controle de prazos).
  • Domínio avançado de planilhas e relatórios de controle (Excel, Google Sheets, Power BI).
  • Perfil organizado, disciplinado, detalhista e orientado a processos.
  • Boa comunicação, postura colaborativa e capacidade de relacionamento com clientes e parceiros.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, negociação e gestão de crises.
  • Histórico em estruturação de processos, governança e projetos complexos.
  • Diferencial : experiência em operações de alto volume, gerenciando dezenas de audiências simultâneas por dia.

O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente inovador e desafiador, com oportunidades para impactar diretamente a transformação do setor jurídico.
  • Cultura colaborativa, onde você terá autonomia para implementar melhorias e influenciar estratégias da empresa.
  • Acesso a tecnologias de ponta e metodologias ágeis aplicadas ao setor jurídico.
  • Modelo de trabalho híbrido/remoto, proporcionando flexibilidade e qualidade de vida.
  • Remuneração competitiva e pacote de benefícios atrativo.


Sobre a EasyJur e nosso DNA

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Líder técnico (Full Stack)
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Essa vaga atenderá um de nossos clientes, o segundo maior fabricante de eletrodomésticos do mundo.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho:

  • Liderar o design técnico: ReactJS (frontend), Java/Spring Boot (backend), Camunda BPMN (workflow) e SQL Server ;
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores e estabelecer padrões de codificação;
  • Superar a replicação da lógica de negócios originária de VBA/Excel;
  • Desenhar arquitetura de cibersegurança, incluindo IAM (Identidade e Acesso), RBAC e conformidade com NIS2 ;
  • Coordenar com DevOps para provisionamento de infraestrutura (Azure ou on-premises) e pipelines CI/CD.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e arquitetura de software e como Tech Lead;
  • Expertise: Arquitetura limpa (Clean Architecture), APIs RESTful, design de banco de dados SQL Server e padrões de integração (SAP, SharePoint);
  • Segurança: Experiência com SSO, auditoria de logs e conformidade regulatória;
  • Inglês avançado.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Inicialmente 10 meses de projeto.

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist
description:
Freelance Regulatory & Study Start-Up Specialist – LATAM - Brazil, Chile and Argentina


Upsilon Global are seeking a freelance regulatory and start-up specialist with solid experience in Ethics Committee submissions for observational studies in LATAM, specifically Chile, Argentina and Brazil.


The role will provide centralized oversight and execution of local submissions across the three countries to ensure quality, consistency and timeline adherence.


Key Details:

Start Date: February 2026

Contract Length: 6 months initially

FTE: Approximately 0.5 FTE

Therapeutic Area: Observational/RWE - infectious diseases

Location: Remote, covering Brazil, Argentina and Chile


Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage regulatory submissions and site start-up activities.
  • Ensure compliance with Swiss and international clinical trial regulations.
  • Liaise with sponsors, investigators, and ethics committees.
  • Track approval timelines and maintain regulatory documentation.
  • Provide guidance on regulatory requirements and study compliance.


Requirements:

  • EC submissions for observational studies
  • Experience managing submissions across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with projects including satellite sites
  • Proactive and solution-oriented
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Ability to work under tight timelines
  • Fluency in English with Spanish/Portuguese beneficial


Experience:

  • EC submission expertise
  • Knowledge of LATAM regulatory landscapes
  • Hands-on experience with EC submissions in LATAM
  • Ability to work independently and drive submissions end-to-end
  • Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills


Please apply via the link, or contact /

title: Tech Recruiter
description:
Atividades:

• Atrair, identificar e triar profissionais por meio da busca ativa nas ferramentas de recrutamento, que atendam aos requisitos técnicos e comportamentais das vagas abertas;

• Estabelecer contato com os candidatos, para apresentar a empresa, os benefícios da posição e os desafios envolvidos no trabalho, promovendo o interesse desses candidatos em participar do processo seletivo;

• Preparar o resumo do candidato com currículo e parecer de entrevista para envio ao Comercial/Cliente;

• Conduzir entrevistas, aplicar testes ou outras técnicas de avaliação, quando necessário;

• Levantar informações sobre a experiência e as referências profissionais dos candidatos para avaliar seu histórico de desempenho e verificar sua aderência frente à cultura e valores da empresa;

• Utilizar habilidades de negociação para identificar as expectativas e necessidades do candidato em relação a sua posição atual e à oferta da empresa;

• Apresentar de forma clara os benefícios da vaga, incluindo possibilidades de desenvolvimento profissional, desafios e oportunidades de crescimento.

• Agendar e participar de entrevistas com clientes, realizar propostas, entre outras atividades.


Requisitos da vaga:

• Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de RH e áreas afins;

• Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;

• Experiência em vagas de tecnologia ou atuação prévia em consultoria de R&S com foco em TI;

• Familiaridade com vocabulário técnico;

• Habilidades desenvolvidas de persuasão, engajamento e empatia.

• Disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Maringá/PR.

title: Assistant Project Manager - E-Commerce Solutions
description:
Solo Media Group is seeking a motivated Assistant Project Manager to support our client project teams and grow into a strategic problem-solver role. If you're eager to learn e-commerce, love organization and communication, and want to develop your career with a fast-growing Shopify agency, this is your opportunity.

About the Role

You'll work alongside our Product Owners and Project Managers, learning how to translate client needs into technical solutions while keeping projects on track. This is a hands-on role where you'll gain exposure to complex e-commerce implementations, stakeholder management, and cross-functional team collaboration.

What You'll Do
  • Support project managers in coordinating client projects and internal development teams
  • Maintain project documentation, timelines, and status updates
  • Facilitate communication between clients, designers, and developers
  • Help troubleshoot issues and identify solutions alongside senior team members
  • Participate in client meetings and learn stakeholder management
  • Track project deliverables and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
  • Assist with scope management and project planning
Must-Haves
  • Fluent bilingual communication (English and Spanish)
  • Strong organizational skills - you can juggle multiple projects without missing details
  • Clear communicator - you can explain complex information to different audiences
  • Eagerness to learn - you're curious about e-commerce and technology
  • Proactive problem-solver - you don't wait to be told what needs fixing
  • Team player - you thrive in collaborative environments
Nice-to-Have
  • Basic understanding of e-commerce or Shopify
  • Exposure to technical projects or software development processes
  • Experience with project management tools
  • Background in client-facing roles
Why Join Us
  • Growth opportunity - clear path to Project Manager and Product Owner roles
  • Work with a fast-growing Shopify Premier Partner agency
  • Learn from experienced PMs on innovative, complex client projects
  • Founder-led company with mentorship and direct access to leadership
  • Competitive benefits including paid time off and holidays
  • Exposure to cutting-edge e-commerce solutions and technologies
Our Culture

We're passionate about solving real problems for our clients. We value people who ask questions, take initiative, and are committed to continuous learning. You'll work with a team that supports your growth and celebrates collaborative success.


Ready to launch your career in e-commerce project management? Let's connect.

title: Tech Lead – Inteligência Artificial (AI)
description:
#RESV57342


Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.



- O que procuramos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead de Inteligência Artificial para liderar tecnicamente projetos estratégicos de desenvolvimento de plataformas de agentes de IA , atuando desde a concepção da arquitetura até a entrega e evolução contínua das soluções.

Essa posição é ideal para quem combina excelência técnica , visão arquitetural e capacidade de liderança , com forte interesse em soluções modernas de IA aplicada a problemas reais de negócio.


- O que você deve ter?

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead / Líder Técnico ou função equivalente.
  • Domínio em Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Experiência em projetos de Inteligência Artificial , Machine Learning ou soluções baseadas em LLMs.
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microsserviços, cloud e arquiteturas modernas.
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica e liderança de times de engenharia.


- Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar tecnicamente projetos de plataformas de agentes de IA (multiagentes, orquestração, integrações com LLMs).
  • Definir arquitetura, padrões técnicos e boas práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar hands-on no desenvolvimento utilizando Python e/ou Node.js .
  • Orientar e mentorar desenvolvedores, garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade do código.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com áreas de produto, arquitetura e negócio.
  • Avaliar e incorporar novas tecnologias, frameworks e abordagens em Inteligência Artificial.


- Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com plataformas de agentes de IA , RAG, LangChain ou frameworks de orquestração.
  • Vivência em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Experiência em produtos de dados, IA generativa ou plataformas internas.
  • Boa comunicação e visão estratégica.



- O que temos pra te oferecer?

  • Atuação em projetos estratégicos de IA , com impacto direto no negócio.
  • Ambiente de alto nível técnico, com autonomia e espaço para inovação.
  • Oportunidade de liderar a construção de soluções modernas e escaláveis de IA.



- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Senior Graphic Web Designer
description:
About the Role


You’ll be our core design lead, working closely with strategy, growth and creative direction. You’ll shape ideas and also execute them — from campaign concepts to ads, landing pages and newsletters.


This is a hands-on role with real creative ownership.


What You’ll Do


Campaigns & Marketing Systems


  • Translate strategy into clear, strong creative concepts across digital and offline channels
  • Design campaign assets with a defined role in the funnel and customer journey
  • Create ad visuals for digital channels (Meta, Google, display, social)
  • Regularly design offline assets such as posters, flyers, brochures, and OOH for selected clients
  • Ensure offline and digital assets feel part of one coherent system
  • Think in systems: how ideas, formats, and visuals repeat, adapt, and scale


Brand & Digital Design


  • Design and evolve brand systems rather than isolated assets
  • Create website and landing page visuals focused on clarity, structure, and conversion
  • Ensure consistency across brand, campaigns, CRM, web, and physical materials
  • Work with developers or page builders to ensure designs are implemented correctly


Email & CRM Design


  • Design newsletters and email journeys as part of a wider marketing system
  • Build or adapt emails using HTML templates or ESP editors
  • Design within real-world email constraints (responsiveness, compatibility)
  • Create reusable visual patterns for CRM and lifecycle communications


UX-Minded Design


  • Apply UX thinking to websites, landing pages, and marketing funnels
  • Create wireframes, flows, or structural layouts when helpful
  • Design for understanding, usability, and decision-making — not decoration
  • Apply UX principles to offline materials where they guide behaviour or action


What We’re Looking For


Must-haves


  • 5+ years’ experience as a designer (agency, studio, or in-house)
  • Minimum B2 level of English
  • A strong portfolio showing thoughtful digital and campaign work
  • Excellent graphic design fundamentals (layout, typography, hierarchy)
  • Experience designing across digital and offline touchpoints
  • Solid understanding of performance-driven and conversion-aware design
  • Working knowledge of HTML for emails/newsletters (no full development required)
  • UX awareness and user-centred thinking
  • Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and make sound creative decisions
  • Availability to work closer to European time


Nice-to-haves


  • UX/UI project experience
  • Experience working in sprints or agile environments
  • Motion basics (After Effects, Lottie, simple animations)
  • Experience with Figma and Adobe CC
  • Interest in systems, automation, or marketing infrastructure


How We Work


  • Small, senior-led team
  • High trust, low bureaucracy
  • Clear briefs and clear expectations
  • Direct client impact and visibility
  • Specialists brought in when needed — you’re not expected to do everything


What We Offer


  • A central creative role with real influence on how BLND works
  • Space to think, not just produce
  • A mix of strategic, digital, and offline projects
  • Flexible working (fully remote)
  • Competitive compensation, based on experience
  • Opportunity to grow into a broader creative leadership role as BLND scales


About BLND


BLND is a marketing engineering agency working with B2B2C companies that don’t have large in-house marketing teams but need structure, clarity, and systems before they scale.


We help businesses connect their business buyers, partners, and end customers through well-designed marketing systems. That means strategy, CRM, automation, data flows, websites, campaigns, and — where relevant — offline materials that all work together.


We don’t focus on producing more content.

We focus on designing how marketing actually works .


Founded in 2023, BLND builds on over 12 years of experience across strategy, design, marketing, and technology. We work in small, senior teams, value clear thinking over noise, and care deeply about quality, ownership, and long-term impact.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
About You

You are a back-end engineer passionate about building scalable, reliable, and maintainable applications. You thrive on writing clean code, applying modern architecture patterns, and leveraging cloud-based solutions. You enjoy solving complex challenges, automating infrastructure, and ensuring that systems are secure, performant, and ready to scale. You’re looking for a company where you can keep growing professionally and directly influence technical excellence.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field; or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in back-end development using Ruby on Rails.
  • Strong experience with AWS services such as Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, and API Gateway.
  • Hands-on experience using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
  • Solid understanding of serverless architectures and AWS Lambda functions.
  • Experience designing and consuming RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis, and background job frameworks (Sidekiq, Resque).
  • Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum methodologies, and proficiency using Jira and Confluence for project tracking.
  • Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience with microservices, GoLang, or Node.js for complementary service integration (nice to have).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain Ruby on Rails applications with a focus on scalability and performance.
  • Build and manage AWS infrastructure components using Terraform and DevOps best practices.
  • Implement and maintain serverless solutions leveraging AWS Lambda and related services.
  • Integrate and maintain APIs and external systems, ensuring reliability and data consistency.
  • Refactor legacy components to improve maintainability, performance, and code clarity.
  • Write and maintain automated tests (RSpec, Minitest) to ensure high code quality and coverage.
  • Monitor application performance and proactively address issues or bottlenecks.
  • Collaborate on CI/CD pipelines, ensuring secure, consistent, and efficient deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews, maintaining high-quality development standards.
  • Engage in Agile ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Work closely with front-end, DevOps, and QA teams to deliver robust, end-to-end solutions.


Additional Information

Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.

Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!

We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.


Some of our perks and benefits:

  • Celebrations
  • Special discounts*
  • Entertainment area*
  • Modern Work Spaces*
  • Great work environment
  • Private medical insurance*


*Benefits may vary according to your location and/or availability. Request further information when applying.

title: Salesforce Consultant / Developer
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Consultant or Developer (minimum 8-10 years of experience) to join our expanding AMS support and Project Delivery team for a leading US-based client. The role requires strong Salesforce expertise in consulting and/or development, excellent communication skills, and the ability to deliver high-quality support and enhancements.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide day-to-day support, maintenance, and enhancement of the client's Salesforce environment.
  • Gather business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
  • Design, configure, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, etc.).
  • Manage and maintain integrations with other systems.
  • Collaborate with client teams and internal technical resources.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve system issues in a timely manner.
  • Maintain system documentation and support user training efforts.


Requirements:

  • Proven experience as a Salesforce Consultant or Developer.
  • Salesforce certifications (Administrator, Platform Developer I/II, Sales/Service Cloud Consultant, etc.) highly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Components (Aura/LWC), Flows.
  • Experience with integration tools and APIs.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and proactively in a remote setting.


Extensive expertise in some of the following areas:

  • B2B and e-Commerce solutions
  • Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, and Marketing Cloud
  • Experience Cloud (Community Cloud)
  • Einstein and AI-driven analytics
  • MuleSoft Integration Suite and Integration Designer Platform (IDP)


Nice to have Qualifications:

  • Experience with ChatGPT 4.0 prompt engineering or similar AI tools, particularly document ingestion use cases, is a significant advantage.

title: Specialist, Project Finance and M&A, LATAM
description:
About the Company:


Recurrent Energy is one of the world’s largest and most geographically diversified utility-scale solar and energy storage project development, ownership, and operations platforms. With an industry-leading team of in-house energy experts, we are a wholly-owned subsidiary of Canadian Solar Inc. and function as Canadian Solar’s global development and power services business.


About the Position:


The Project Finance and M&A Specialist will play a critical role in supporting the company’s growth across LATAM by performing advanced financial analysis, developing robust financial models, and assisting in the structuring and execution of complex transactions. Working closely with the Project Finance and M&A team, this role provides analytical, strategic, and execution support throughout the transaction lifecycle — from origination and due diligence to closing and portfolio management.


Responsibilities:


  • Business Acumen and Financial Literacy - Demonstrates an understanding of relevant financial metrics and concepts.
  • Resource Planning - Plans for various possible timelines and contingencies for completing assigned work.
  • Collaborative - Displays positive demeanor in interactions with others both on the team and cross-functionally.
  • Project Structuring & Execution – Understands the legal, technical, and financial components of project finance structures; effectively contributes to transaction execution from term sheet to financial close.
  • Communication & Influence – Clearly articulates financial insights and recommendations; influences decision-making through well-reasoned analysis.
  • Results Orientation – Drives deliverables to completion with a focus on accuracy, timeliness, and value creation.
  • Adaptability & Learning Agility – Quickly assimilates new information, adjusts to changing deal dynamics, and continuously seeks to enhance technical and market knowledge.
  • Leadership & Mentoring – Provides guidance to junior members, reviews work outputs, and helps raise the overall quality of the team’s deliverables.


Qualifications and Experience:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in project finance, M&A, or a similar role.
  • Proficiency in financial modeling tools (Excel, VBA).
  • Experience in cross-border transactions within LATAM markets.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently and take ownership of complex workstreams.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, capable of explaining technical results to financial stakeholders.

title: Senior DataOps Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement



At Andela, we know our strengths lie in our diverse community whose talents, perspectives, backgrounds and orientations we take pride in. Andela is committed to nurturing a work environment where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Everyone has the right to work in a professional atmosphere that promotes equal employment opportunities and prohibits discriminatory practices.

Andela provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to factors including but not limited to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy (including breastfeeding), genetic information, HIV/AIDS or any other medical status, family or parental status, marital status, amnesty or status as a covered veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

The client operates in the health and information services domain, with a strong focus on enabling data-driven decision-making at enterprise scale. Their mission centers on building a modern, cloud-based data platform that serves as a single source of truth for business intelligence, analytics, machine learning, and AI use cases. The culture emphasizes data quality, governance, scalability, and collaboration across engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.


About the role

This role is focused on building and operating a robust data platform on Azure using Databricks. The engineer will play a key part in DataOps, ensuring data completeness, accuracy, and reliability across enterprise-scale pipelines. You will design monitoring frameworks, implement data quality checks, and support governance initiatives. The role is highly collaborative, working closely with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders. It also requires strong ownership and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.


Responsibilities

  • Design and develop a robust monitoring stack for jobs executed in Azure Data Factory, Databricks, MS Fabric, and other platform tools
  • Assist in building and maintaining data catalogs in Unity Catalog and Purview
  • Design and implement a scalable framework for data quality checks across hundreds of columns on large datasets
  • Monitor data completeness and accuracy to ensure published data meets acceptable criteria
  • Collaborate with data engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality data solutions
  • Troubleshoot and optimize big data workflows for performance and scalability
  • Support governance and oversight of data pipelines and transformation activities
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in big data and analytics


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of overall experience in Data Engineering / DataOps
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience in a Databricks environment (any cloud)
  • Strong experience with DataOps practices
  • Strong experience with data catalogs
  • Strong experience implementing data quality checks at scale
  • Strong Python experience
  • Strong proficiency in Data Governance processes and tools
  • Experience with Purview and/or Unity Catalog
  • Advanced SQL skills
  • Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed computing
  • Experience with ETL processes, data cleaning, and large-scale data transformation
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an analytics-driven mindset
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience


Nice to have skills

  • Experience with Azure cloud services (preferred)
  • Experience with AWS
  • Experience with GCP
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
  • Experience with DevOps practices


Conditions

  • 100% Remote role , primarily aligned to UTC-5 (EST) with a minimum of 5 hours overlap required
  • Contractor role – 6-month contract, renewable based on budget and performance
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week)
  • BYOD requirement

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably in EdTech, SAAS or STEM publishing.
  • Experience in science communications, academic outreach or other customer-facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.
